targeted_vitest.command: PATH=<Node 22>/bin:$PATH nice -n 10 node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/unit/hls/hls-edge-worker.test.ts tests/unit/player/playback-token-renewal.test.tsx tests/unit/player/self-hls.test.ts tests/unit/components/playback-viewer-cache-safety.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=json --outputFile=<evidence>/playback-targeted-vitest.json

boundaries: No generated Prisma client, actual DB, Next HTTP, auth session/logout operation, Cloudflare runtime, R2 or browser playback.
Patron gate explicitly off; paid-entitlement rows are synthetic. No billing or active production configuration assertion.
Runtime enum strings derived from pinned schema, no client installed or replaced.
Cache fake only supports tested full-body GET behavior, no real browser/CDN TTL eviction or Range semantics.
Logout/suspension/unpublish/removal states are supplied snapshots; actual mutation endpoints were not executed.
Clock advances are simulated; no wall-clock TTL measurement. No fixture tokens or secrets emitted.
harness_history: First scoped run exited 0. Added a transparent observer of the actual central access decision and assertions for NOT_FOUND, then final run exited 0. No application change. Clock covers Date.now, default new Date and ctx.now; final output remains byte-identical after fixing wall-clock dependence in helper defaults.
